Entry.JapaneseText: ……うむ、心配ない。 しばらくすれば 目を覚ますじゃろう
Entry.EnglishText: No need to worry. He should wake up shortly.
Thank you, sir.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……村の恩人の騎士様に ケンカを売るなんて とんでもない乱暴者たちだ
Entry.EnglishText: You caused quite a ruckus, starting a fight with the Crystal Knights who saved us.

Entry.JapaneseText: 気が付いたら すぐに村を出て行ってくだされ
Entry.EnglishText: Once the boy has awoken, I ask that you leave the village immediately.

Entry.JapaneseText: それからサーシャが余計な事を 話したようだが、村の悪い噂を 他所に流さんでくだされよ
Entry.EnglishText: And you even dragged Sasha into spreading rumors to you. Please take your wild rumors about our village elsewhere.

Entry.JapaneseText: なんだい、急に態度 変えちゃって、やな感じっ！
Entry.EnglishText: Yeesh, talk about a 180!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ごめんなさい。 村長は貧しいこの村を 温泉で豊かにしようと
Entry.EnglishText: ...I'm so sorry. All the mayor wanted was to enrich this struggling town with our hot springs.

Entry.JapaneseText: ずっと頑張ってきた人なの。 誰より村を愛してるから あんなきつい言い方を……
Entry.EnglishText: He's been working long and hard for this. He loves this village more than anyone,. That's why he was so harsh on you...

Entry.JapaneseText: オレ、スピルーンを集める事が 誰かの迷惑になるなんて 考えもしなかったよ……
Entry.EnglishText: I didn't expect trying to recover the Spirune would cause people trouble...
...Does this village... have cold water?

Entry.JapaneseText: ええ、村の裏手に 冷たい清水が湧く泉があるわ。 温泉と並ぶ村の名物なのよ
Entry.EnglishText: We do. There's a spring with cool, clear water just behind the village. It's our other specialty, aside from our hot springs.

Entry.JapaneseText: お兄ちゃん……頭…… 冷たい方が……いいと思う
Entry.EnglishText: I think... cold would be better for <Hisui>'s head...

Entry.JapaneseText: そうだね。<Hisui>の ヤカン頭を冷やすために その清水をくみに行こうよ！
Entry.EnglishText: Nice call. Let's go fetch some water to try and cool off this hot-head!
...Right.

Entry.JapaneseText: ごめんなさい、村長…… 私が泉の場所を教えて しまったせいで……
Entry.EnglishText: I'm sorry, mayor. It's my fault for telling her the location of the spring...

Entry.JapaneseText: 気にするな…… 郷を守るのは村長の務め…… サーシャこそ無事でよかった
Entry.EnglishText: Don't be... as mayor, it's my duty to protect the nest... I'm just glad you're not hurt.

Entry.JapaneseText: それより、みなさん…… あんなに冷たい態度をとった わしを助けてくださるとは……
Entry.EnglishText: Putting that aside... I'm surprised you were so quick to help, after how I treated you...

Entry.JapaneseText: 気にしないでよ。 優しい人を守るのは ソーマ使いの務め……だからね
Entry.EnglishText: Don't sweat it. It's a Somatics duty to protect the kind, after all.

Entry.JapaneseText: 村長さん。この郷に 煉獄竜を目撃した人がいるはず なんだけど、知りませんか？
Entry.EnglishText: Mr. Mayor, we've heard someone has sighted the purgatorial dragon. Do you know who it was?
...Well, that would be me...

Entry.JapaneseText: 数ヶ月前——偶然、わしは バメル火山の爆発を対岸から 見たのです
Entry.EnglishText: A few months ago, I just happened to Bamel volcano erupt from the opposite shore.

Entry.JapaneseText: 炎の中にあやつはいた…… 火口からあふれる溶岩の中を 平然と歩む真っ赤な竜が！
Entry.EnglishText: And amongst the flames... I saw a bright red dragon effortlessly walking through the overflowing lava!

Entry.JapaneseText: バメル火山…… このグースの郷の 南西の半島にある火山ね
Entry.EnglishText: Bamel volcano... if I recall correctly, that's on the peninsular southwest of Goose.

Entry.JapaneseText: 活動を停止した火山と思われて いたのに、数ヶ月前、突然爆発して ふもとの村を全滅させたのよね
Entry.EnglishText: The volcano was thought to be dormant, but just a few months ago, it suddenly erupted and wiped out the village at its base.

Entry.JapaneseText: 違う……街を滅ぼしたのは 火山の爆発ではないのですじゃ
Entry.EnglishText: No... it wasn't the eruption that devastated the village.

Entry.JapaneseText: わしは見たのです……煉獄竜が 溶岩に閉ざされたふもとの村の 人間を捕まえ……食っている姿を！
Entry.EnglishText: I saw it... the purgatorial dragon was snatching people away from the village which is now sealed off by lava... and eating them!

Entry.JapaneseText: まるで狩りだな。もしかすると 噴火自体にヴォルガジョーズが 関係してるのかもしれない……
Entry.EnglishText: It's like a hunting ground. Perhaps Volgajoz itself played a part in the volcano erupting...

Entry.JapaneseText: 溶岩の海を泳ぎ、火山を噴火させる 人食いの竜…………
Entry.EnglishText: A man-eating dragon that can swim through lava and even make volcanoes erupt...

Entry.JapaneseText: うふふ、<Beryl>。 いい絵のモデルに なりそうじゃない？
Entry.EnglishText: Hehe, wouldn't it make for a great portrait, Beryl?

Entry.JapaneseText: ならないよっ！ てか、一生お知り合いにも なりたくないよぉっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Oh HECK NO! I'd rather go my whole life never even seeing it, thank you!

Entry.JapaneseText: 超〜同意だけどさ クリードをボコるためには そうも言ってらんないんだよねぇ
Entry.EnglishText: I'm SO with you on that, but I guess we gotta if we wanna defeat Creed,

Entry.JapaneseText: なんとしてもヴォルガジョーズの フレアホーンを手に入れ 飛行ソーマをエボルブさせねば！
Entry.EnglishText: We must obtain the flare horn and evolve the flying Soma!

Entry.JapaneseText: インカローズは もうすぐサンドリオンが 転送術を発動するって言ってたよ
Entry.EnglishText: Incarose said Cendrillon's transfer Arte is nearly ready too...

Entry.JapaneseText: 事は一刻を争う！ すぐにバメル火山に向かおう
Entry.EnglishText: Time is of the essence! Let us hurry to Bamel volcano at one!

Entry.JapaneseText: 応急手当はしたが 全身ボロボロだ…… 当分動けねぇだろうな
Entry.EnglishText: I gave him some first aid, but he's so beaten up. He probably won't be up and about for a while.
...Shing... are you all... unharmed?
Chal...

Entry.JapaneseText: バイロクスとペリドットは …………いないんだな？
Entry.EnglishText: Byrox and Peridot are really... gone.
...Yeah.

Entry.JapaneseText: そうか………… ……だが、心配するな。 あいつらの分まで僕が……
Entry.EnglishText: I see... But do not fear. I will go forth in their stead...

Entry.JapaneseText: か、体が動かない…… くそっ、僕はなんて 情けない隊長なんだ……ッ
Entry.EnglishText: I-I can't move my body... Curses, what a pathetic excuse for a captain I am.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……もうてめぇは用済みだ。 おとなしく寝てろ
Entry.EnglishText: ...You've done your part. Now stay in your damn bed.

Entry.JapaneseText: お兄ちゃん、そんな言い方って！
Entry.EnglishText: Hisui, you don't have to say it like that!

Entry.JapaneseText: 無理に動いたら こいつは死ぬぞ？
Entry.EnglishText: Why? Fact is if he moves, he'll die.

Entry.JapaneseText: こいつらは、そこまでして 俺たちを助けてくれたんだッ！ 十分すぎるぜ……
Entry.EnglishText: They gave everything to save us! That's more than enough...

Entry.JapaneseText: それに、俺たちといたら こいつは泣く事もできねぇ……
Entry.EnglishText: Besides... He should have the chance to grieve properly, yeah?

Entry.JapaneseText: <Hisui>…… 僕のソーマ『バルハイト』は お前たちの母上の形見だったな？
Entry.EnglishText: Hisui... My Soma Warheit was a momento left behind my your mother, correct?

Entry.JapaneseText: 今のバルハイトは てめぇらの絆がエボルブさせた 新しいソーマさ
Entry.EnglishText: The current Warheit is a new Soma now, one evolved by our bonds.

Entry.JapaneseText: 我が隊だけではない…… 我々全員の絆が生んだ翼だ
Entry.EnglishText: And I don't mean my squad alone... they're wings born of the bonds between each and every one of us.

Entry.JapaneseText: 絆の力で生まれ変わった バルハイト—— 『リアンハイト』……かしら？
Entry.EnglishText: A Warheit born anew with the bonds between us—how about we call it “Reinheit”?

Entry.JapaneseText: リアンハイト！ うん、なかなか芸術的な いい名前だよ！
Entry.EnglishText: Ooh, Reinheit! I like it, it's a real artsy kinda name!

Entry.JapaneseText: 絆の翼、リアンハイト—— 我らの想いも その名とともに飛ぼう
Entry.EnglishText: Wings of bonds, Reinheit—Yes, let our feelings take flight by that name.

Entry.JapaneseText: うん、どんなに離れてたって スピリアは一緒だよ！
Entry.EnglishText: Yeah. Our Spirias are together, no matter the distance!
What the heck was THAT~?!

Entry.JapaneseText: 音声識別。 これは、サンドリオンの 転送術発動音だ
Entry.EnglishText: Noise identified. That was the sound of Cendrillon's transfer Arte activating.

Entry.JapaneseText: いけない！ すぐにサンドリオンに 向かいましょう！
Entry.EnglishText: No! We must depart for Cendrillon at once!
...Then let's go.
...Shing.

Entry.JapaneseText: ひとつだけ約束しろ…… 絶対に生きて帰って来い
Entry.EnglishText: Promise me just one thing... Promise me you'll make it back alive.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……仲間のために涙を流すのは 一度でたくさんだから……な
Entry.EnglishText: I fear I do not have the tears to shed should I lose any more dear comrades of mine...
...Yeah, I promise!

Entry.EnglishText: Money owned: % gald %: % gald
Do you want to rest?

Entry.JapaneseText: 泊まる 泊まらない
Entry.EnglishText: Stay Don't stay

Entry.JapaneseText: <Red>オールドマイン街道<Normal>のすべてを 踏破しました
Entry.EnglishText: Completed your journey through <Red>Oldmine Highway<Normal>.
They're passed out...
Curestone Store
Welcome!

Entry.JapaneseText: ありがとうございました
Entry.EnglishText: Thank you very much.
Inn

Entry.JapaneseText: ようこそおいでました
Entry.EnglishText: Ah, welcome.
Will you stay the night?
Please, come by again.

Entry.JapaneseText: 代金が足りないようです……
Entry.EnglishText: Not quite enough to cover the cost, I'm afraid...
Do come by again.
Heya, come on in!
Come again, now!
Whaddya need?
Thanks.
Welcome.
Thank you very much.
Hmm, which to choose...?

Entry.JapaneseText: 孫へのミヤゲを選ぶのを 手伝ってくれんかね？
Entry.EnglishText: Would you mind helping me pick out a souvenir for my grandkids?

Entry.JapaneseText: グースの郷も 湯治客が減ったのぅ……
Entry.EnglishText: The hot springs aren't getting as many visitors as it used to...

Entry.JapaneseText: 温泉友達も減っちまって さびしいよ……
Entry.EnglishText: It's a real shame I've got no buddies to soak with anymore...

Entry.JapaneseText: 恐怖にのみこまちゃイカン
Entry.EnglishText: Wallowing in fear will do you no good.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……統一戦争の時も 恐怖にのまれた奴から 死んでいったもんさ……
Entry.EnglishText: ...Even back during the Unification War, folks died from being consumed by their fear.

Entry.JapaneseText: ここのお湯は、よく効くねぇ！
Entry.EnglishText: The water here is simply magic!

Entry.JapaneseText: ギックリ腰が スッカリよくなったよ♪
Entry.EnglishText: My back pain's just melting away! ♪

Entry.JapaneseText: ギックリ腰が治っても 魔物だらけの世界になったら 意味がないよ……
Entry.EnglishText: Even if I fix my back, what's the use if the world's overrun by monsters?

Entry.JapaneseText: やっぱり、のんびり温泉に つかれる平和な世界は 長続きしないのかねぇ……
Entry.EnglishText: I suppose such a peaceful world where you can relax in the hot spring without a care can't last forever...

Entry.JapaneseText: く、く、黒い月が バケモノだったなんてっ!?
Entry.EnglishText: Th-Th-The Ebony Moon was a monster this whole time?!

Entry.JapaneseText: せっかく治った腰が また抜けちゃったよぉ……
Entry.EnglishText: I just finished healing my back, and then I pulled it again out of shock...

Entry.JapaneseText: 温泉玉藻はうめぇなぁ！
Entry.EnglishText: The seaweed here is scrumptious!

Entry.JapaneseText: 温泉玉藻をアツアツの ゴハンにかけると たまらねぇんだ♪
Entry.EnglishText: And strung on top of some warm fluffy rice? Mmm! It's to die for!
Oww...

Entry.JapaneseText: ここに来る途中 ゼロムとかいう 例の魔物に襲われたんだ
Entry.EnglishText: I was attacked by one of those xerom on the way here.

Entry.JapaneseText: なんとか逃げられたが 温泉で傷治療するハメに なっちまったよ……
Entry.EnglishText: I managed to get outta there and came to heal up in the hot spring, but the place is a total mess...

Entry.JapaneseText: ウィ〜…… 全部ユメさ……ヒック……
Entry.EnglishText: Ahh... It's all a just dream... *hic*

Entry.JapaneseText: 黒い月がスピリアを喰う怪物 だなんてユメに決まってらぁ！ ……ウェップ…………
Entry.EnglishText: The Ebony Moon turnin' into some Spiria eating monster's aaall just a dream! *hic*
